title: Moving buildings.
officialText:
Buildings shall not hereafter be moved into the fire district or to another lot in the fire district
unless the building is of a type of construction permitted in the fire district.
SECTION BC D104
BUILDINGS LOCATED PARTIALLY IN
THE FIRE DISTRICT
